description:
Check how ready one web page is to be read and cited by AI assistants: whether robots.txt lets the AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) in, llms.txt, the sitemap, structured data, headings, trust signals, meta tags and a Wikidata entry. Returns a 0-100 score, an A-F grade, the score per category, the main issues and the raw signals.

Use this tool when the user asks whether a website is ready for AI search, why AI might not cite a page, or what to fix on it -- phrases like 'audit our homepage for AI', 'can ChatGPT crawl our site', 'GEO check of example.com'.

It checks the page itself. It does not measure what AI assistants answer about the brand; that needs a Refora workspace.

Example question: 'Is kassaro.se ready for AI search?'

url.description: The page to check: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com.
